members.contribution: Home and The club pages: semantic structure, noticeboard hero, club principles, Bootstrap FAQ accordion and responsive page styling. Shared responsibility: navigation, footer, typography and final design integration.

Gatherings page: event cards, category filters, accessible filter states and live count, semantic timetable, customized Bootstrap table and responsive layouts. Shared responsibility: check all pages at 375, 768 and 1280 px.

Field notes and The toolkit pages: editorial layout, expandable notes, original paper illustration, customized Bootstrap supply checkboxes, downloadable activity guide and print stylesheet. Shared responsibility: content consistency and asset credits.

Make a plan page: Bootstrap grid and form controls, labels and validation, local save/restore/edit/delete, calendar reminder download, and responsive summary panel. Shared responsibility: interaction, keyboard and invalid-input checks.

allocation_status: Assigned page ownership and responsibilities; individual commit history must reflect each member's own work.
reflection: OFFLINE brings a screen-free student club into six connected pages with a shared visual style. The implementation combines semantic HTML, a meaningful timetable and form, Bootstrap components, CSS Grid, Flexbox and custom media queries. It demonstrates how reusable design rules keep a multi-page website consistent while each page serves a different purpose. The interactive features connect HTML controls to browser state, validation, accessible feedback and downloadable files. Responsive and keyboard checks show why verification is part of front-end development. The local planner also makes the boundary between a static interface and a real booking service clear; server-side reservations remain a possible extension for the Endterm and Final project.
